skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic economic principles applicable to household economics and farm management.
Develop the ability to build strategies and plan production for households and farms.
Manage land resources effectively in household and farm settings.
Manage capital efficiently in household and farm contexts.
Manage labor resources effectively in household and farm environments.
Manage sales and marketing processes in household and farm operations.
Manage risks associated with household and farm operations.
Measure and evaluate performance in household and farm management.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems in household and farm management.
Work collaboratively in teams to manage household and farm operations.
Develop self-learning abilities to continuously improve in household and farm management.
Develop effective presentation skills for communicating plans and strategies.
